name: Topic 7 - Self Correcting Auditor - Rate Limit Friendly

parameters.text: =Audit this one transaction: {{ JSON.stringify($json.original) }}. Initial validation errors: {{ JSON.stringify($json.initial_errors) }}. You MUST call Transaction_Validation_Tool once with a JSON string containing transaction_id, customer_id, amount, currency, status. Return the structured fields transaction_id, customer_id, amount, currency, payment_status, audit_status, corrections, issues, reason. If the tool reports invalid, use REJECTED.
